Someone died at the top of a remote mountain in {wiki:Chyllfroest} carrying something very valuable to survive the cold. Climb to the top of the mountain, use the pile of bones and you receive a {item:Tinder Box}. It is only possible between 1 April and 1 May, when the island is accessible, and you can repeat it every 20 hours.
Someone died on a remote mountain, taking with them something extremely valuable for surviving the harsh conditions there.
Only between **1 April and 1 May** each year, when the island of {wiki:Chyllfroest} is accessible.
The {spell:Levitate} spell (needed on the 5th floor of the mountain to climb to the top and then to come back down)
You can repeat the quest every **20 hours** while the island is open.
1. Getting to the top of the mountain

Between 1 April and 1 May, start from **Svargrond** and go to the {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls} cave on the way to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} shortcut. Instead of going down and following the shortcut, head **west**, towards the Quara Scouts cave. The ice "bridge" to the island is at {coord:32068,31093,7}; cross it to reach {wiki:Chyllfroest}. Along the way there are {wiki:Chakoyas}, {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants} and {creature:Frost Giantess|Frost Giantesses}.

Go to {wiki:Chyllfroest Mountain|Chyllfroest Mountain} and climb to the **top** (6th floor above ground). On the 1st floor there is a hole leading to the {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} and on the 3rd floor a ramp to the upper floor of the Frost Dragons cave: ignore them and keep climbing. On the **5th floor** (no creatures) use the {spell:Levitate} spell on the **east** side to go up to the 6th floor.
Spot where you use Levitate to reach the top
Location of the pile of bones with the Tinder Box
At the top of the mountain you find a {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|pile of bones}. Use it to receive a {item:Tinder Box}.

Go back the same way: at the top use {spell:Levitate} to go down from the 6th to the 5th floor on the east side, go down the mountain by the same stairs and ramps to the ground and cross the ice bridge at {coord:32068,31093,7} again to the east, back to the Frost Trolls cave and to **Svargrond**.
If you have a {item:Fireproof Horn} (from the Chakoyas), use it on the Tinder Box to make the {item:Melting Horn} that you can use to tame the Ursagrodon.
